sealed_proposal.scope: Shared full real orthogonal-group Haar probability: Section2 first paragraph; AppendixB2.1 row reflection distribution invariance, and Section4.1 Haar O(d). Not determinant-conditioned law, component half-mass, adaptive posterior, seed independence or either main result.

proposed_signatures.existsUnique_orthogonalHaar:
theorem existsUnique_orthogonalHaar (n : ℕ) :
    ∃! μ : Measure (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ),
      IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ μ.IsHaarMeasure
proposed_signatures.orthogonalHaar_spec:
theorem orthogonalHaar_spec (n : ℕ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (orthogonalHaar n) ∧ (orthogonalHaar n).IsHaarMeasure ∧
      ∀ μ : Measure (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ),
        IsProbabilityMeasure μ → μ.IsHaarMeasure → μ = orthogonalHaar n
proposed_signatures.orthogonalHaar_map_mul_left:
theorem orthogonalHaar_map_mul_left (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (orthogonalHaar n).map (fun O => Q * O) = orthogonalHaar n

sealed_proposal.proposed_definition:
noncomputable def orthogonalHaar (n : ℕ) :
    Measure (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :=
  Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))
sealed_proposal.implementation_context: Private CompactSpace instance for full orthogonal group must be constructed internally. Canonical topology is the inherited matrix subspace topology. Mathlib supplies no MeasurableSpace instance for this matrix subtype, so exact private typing definition sets it to borel of that topology, with proof of BorelSpace and second countability as displayed. These definitions are part of sealed meaning, not public assumptions. IsHaarMeasure means left invariant, finite on compact sets and positive on nonempty opens.
sealed_proposal.definition_discipline: Characterized source object. First compile and independently proof-review existsUnique_orthogonalHaar (real well-definedness) before writing the production orthogonalHaar definition. Then define by the actual Mathlib haarMeasure constructor normalized on the full compact group; a separately named spec/uniqueness theorem will prove the characterization. No fallback/off-source default.
sealed_proposal.source_range_delta: The shared background interface is valid for all natural finite n, including n0 singleton group; this is a disclosed generalization of the paper application n>=3/d>=2. It does not claim two determinant components at n0 or conditioned laws.
